summary: Phase 6 prep script retrain_alpha_models.py - All 17 unit tests passed + CLI smoke test + manual verification of all acceptance criteria. Script correctly generates versioned .joblib artifacts for Strategist + Auditor models with calibration report and training manifest. NO broker calls, NO env mutation, NO executor wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: Script correctly implements dry-run default mode - no artifacts written unless --write-artifact flag is passed
Versioned paths follow correct format: strategist_<sha>_<UTC-stamp>.joblib and auditor_<sha>_<UTC-stamp>.joblib

Report schema stable with all 15 required keys: status, source, git_sha, timestamp, window_days, rows_scanned, rows_used, rows_skipped, skip_reasons, feature_count, class_balance_strategist, class_balance_auditor, strategist, auditor, artifacts
Manifest JSON contains all required fields: source='alpha_retrain', git_sha, timestamp, window_days, rows_used, strategist_metrics, auditor_metrics

NO forbidden imports: script does NOT import services.alpaca_client, services.kraken_client, services.broker_registry, services.smart_order_service, services.ml.broker_wire, services.ml.executors, services.ml.pipeline
NO env mutation: STRATEGIST_ARTIFACT, AUDITOR_ARTIFACT, PHASE6_ENFORCE_*, ALPACA_API_KEY, KRAKEN_API_KEY unchanged after write-artifact run
skip_reasons counter correctly classifies: missing_symbol, no_decision_log, missing_features, missing_pnl
reconstruct_features returns None when any of the 6 perception sub-scores (event_shock, regime, drawdown, liquidity, system_health, pacing) is missing
label_from_outcome correctly maps: pnl > 0 → BUY/AUDIT_OK, pnl < 0 → SELL/AUDIT_BLOCK, pnl ≈ 0 → NO_TRADE/AUDIT_OK
STATUS_NOT_ENOUGH_ROWS returned when rows_used < DEFAULT_MIN_ROWS=50 (clean exit, no crash)
make lint-fast passes (no regression on Phase 6 invariant bundle)

success_rate.backend: 100% (17 unit tests passed + CLI smoke test + manual verification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: retrain_alpha_models.py is a Phase 6 prep CLI script. Key findings: (1) Default mode is dry-run (no artifacts written), (2) --write-artifact flag persists strategist + auditor + manifest to versioned paths, (3) --window-days controls cutoff for paper_trades + alpha_decision_log lookup, (4) --json writes report to file, (5) Live preview pod returned NOT_ENOUGH_ROWS (172 trades scanned, 0 paired with decision logs in 1-day window - expected since no alpha_decision_log entries exist), (6) No HTTP endpoints - test via CLI or by importing run_retrain() with synthetic ExtractionResult

cli_flags.--write-artifact: Persists strategist + auditor + manifest to versioned paths (default: dry-run)
cli_flags.--window-days: Controls cutoff for paper_trades + alpha_decision_log lookup (default: 14)
cli_flags.--json: Writes report JSON to specified path

status_codes.NO_DB: server.db is None / unimportable (clean exit, no crash)

skip_reasons.missing_symbol: Trade has no symbol or empty symbol
skip_reasons.no_decision_log: No matching decision log entry for (symbol, lane)
skip_reasons.missing_features: Decision doc missing any of 6 perception sub-scores
skip_reasons.missing_pnl: Trade has no usable P&L signal

live_cli_output.note: Expected - preview pod has paper_trades but no alpha_decision_log entries to pair with
